layout_dets.text: The directors present their report and the audited financial statements for the financial year ended 30 June 2025.

layout_dets.text: Principal Activity and Review of the Business

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Senus (previously known as Farmeye) provides Measurement, Reporting and Verification technology solutions to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: land use sector. Our focus is on soil health, carbon sequestration, habitat mapping and water quality assessments for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: supply chains and land use managers. Senus is primarily a software development company that aims to enable the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: measurement and verification of land and its environmental assets

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Senus is measuring and monitoring natural capital which is the earth supply of natural resources we rely on for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: production of food, textiles and building materials. The management of natural capital is pivotal for the sustainable

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: utilisation of our resources into the future. Senus technologies allow the corporates and governments to measure,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: monitor and verify the natural capital metrics of their supply chains. Senus had a strong performance with the product

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: set to date. The company acquired new corporate clients in the financial period and new product sets have also

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: commenced development of new product offerings. The next three years will see the commencement of several

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: international government and corporate based programmes around soil health, carbon sequestration and habitats at

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: farm level. Senus is well positioned to take a market share of this MRV (Measurement, Reporting and Verification)

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: activity in the coming years. This financial period saw a major investment into software and technologies along with

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the investment into establishing a new office in the UK.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Basis of preparation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The financial statements have been prepared on the going concern basis and in accordance with the historical

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: cost convention except for certain properties and financial instruments that are measured at revalued amounts

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or fair values, as explained in the accounting policies below. Historical cost is generally based on the fair

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: value of the consideration given in exchange for assets.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The financial statements are presented in Euro, which is the functional currency of the parent company. For

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: consolidation purposes, the financial statements of the UK subsidiary, which are prepared in GBP, have been

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: translated into Euro using the average exchange rate for the year for income and expense items, and the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: closing exchange rate for balance sheet items, where applicable. The financial reporting framework that has

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: been applied in their preparation is the Companies Act 2014 and FRS 102 “The Financial Reporting Standard

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland” issued by the Financial Reporting Council.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The company qualifies as a small company as defined by section 280B of the Companies Act 2014 in respect

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: of the financial year, and has applied the rules of the ‘Small Companies Regime' in accordance with section

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: 280C of the Companies Act 2014.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Turnover

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Turnover is measured at the fair value of the consideration received or receivable for goods supplied and

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: services rendered, net of discounts and Value Added Tax.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Revenue from the sale of goods is recognised when the significant risks and rewards of ownership have

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: transferred to the buyer, usually on dispatch of the goods; the amount of revenue can be measured reliably; it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is probable that the associated economic benefits will flow to the entity and the costs incurred or to be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: incurred in respect of the transactions can be measured reliably.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Tangible assets and depreciation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Tangible assets are stated at cost or at valuation, less accumulated depreciation. The charge to depreciation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is calculated to write off the original cost or valuation of tangible assets, less their estimated residual value,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: over their expected useful lives as follows:

layout_dets.text: Trade and other debtors

layout_dets.text: Borrowing costs

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Borrowing costs relating to the acquisition of assets are capitalised at the appropriate rate by adding them to

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the cost of assets being acquired. Investment income earned on the temporary investment of specific

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: borrowings pending their expenditure on the assets is deducted from the borrowing costs eligible for

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: capitalisation. All other borrowing costs are recognised in profit or loss in the period in which they are incurred.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Trade and other creditors

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Trade and other creditors are initially recognised at fair value and thereafter stated at amortised cost using the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: stated at cost.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Related parties

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For the purposes of these financial statements a party is considered to be related to the company if:

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the party has the ability, directly or indirectly, through one or more intermediaries to control the company

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: or exercise significant influence over the company in making financial and operating policy decisions or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: has joint control over the company;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the company and the party are subject to common control;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the party is an associate of the company or forms part of a joint venture with the company;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the party is a member of key management personnel of the company or the company's parent, or a close

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: family member of such as an individual, or is an entity under the control, joint control or significant

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: influence of such individuals;

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the party is a close family member of a party referred to above or is an entity under the control or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: significant influence of such individuals; or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: the party is a post-employment benefit plan which is for the benefit of employees of the company or of any

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: entity that is a related party of the company.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Close family members of an individual are those family members who may be expected to influence, or be

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: influenced by, that individual in their dealings with the company.

layout_dets.text: The company operates a defined contribution pension scheme. The assets of the scheme are held separately

layout_dets.text: from those of the company in an independently administered fund.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Taxation and deferred taxation

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Current tax represents the amount expected to be paid or recovered in respect of taxable profits for the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: financial year and is calculated using the tax rates and laws that have been enacted or substantially enacted

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: at the Balance Sheet date.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: The taxation expense represents the aggregate amount of current and deferred tax recognised in the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: reporting period. Tax is recognised in the statement of comprehensive income, except to the extent that it

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: relates to items recognised in other comprehensive income or directly in capital and reserves. In this case, tax

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.text: Financial Instruments

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: A financial asset or a financial liability is recognised only when the company becomes a party to the

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Basic financial instruments are initially recognised at the transaction price, unless the arrangement constitutes

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Debt instruments are subsequently measured at amortised cost.

layout_dets.text: Where investments in non-convertible preference shares and non-puttable ordinary shares or preference

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Other financial instruments, including derivatives, are initially recognised at fair value, unless payment for an

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: which case the asset is measured at the present value of the future payments discounted at a market rate of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: interest for a similar debt instrument.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: Other financial instruments are subsequently measured at fair value, with any changes recognised in profit or

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: loss, with the exception of hedging instruments in a designated hedging relationship.

layout_dets.text: Financial assets that are measured at cost or amortised cost are reviewed for objective evidence of

layout_dets.label: ocr_text

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: is recognised in profit or loss immediately.

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
layout_dets.text: For all equity instruments regardless of significance, and other financial assets that are individually significant,

layout_dets.label: ocr_text
